name: Otobe Akira
source: Appearing exclusively in Yoigoshi-hen, serving as the protagonist. He comes to Hinamizawa 20 years after the Great Hinamizawa Disaster with Akutagawa, Chiaki, and Machi [spoiler] as part of a group suicide[/spoiler]. He gets separated from the group he was with and meets "Mion Sonozaki".
translation: Appearing exclusively in Yoigoshi-hen, serving as the protagonist. He comes to Hinamizawa 20 years after the Great Hinamizawa Disaster with Akutagawa, Chiaki, and Machi [spoiler] as part of a group suicide[/spoiler]. He gets separated from the group he was with and meets "Mion Sonozaki".
